records.title: PlayStation cross-save can fail during network instability
records.summary: Using cross-save on PlayStation may return an error when the network connection is unstable.
safeActions: Do not overwrite another platform's known-good save while the error is present.
Confirm the source platform still has the intended save.
Retry only after the network connection is stable.
escalation: Create a fresh manual save before another upload attempt.
Use the official cross-save page to confirm linked platforms.

records.title: Caught fish may not move in certain areas
records.summary: Fish caught in certain areas may remain motionless.
safeActions: Treat this as a presentation defect unless progression is blocked.
Capture the location and platform before reporting it.
escalation: Reload from a recent manual save only if the interaction remains blocked.

records.title: Greymane faction quests can stall as Damiane or Oongka
records.summary: Greymane faction quests may not progress while playing as Damiane or Oongka.
safeActions: Switch back to Kliff before continuing the affected faction quest.
Make a manual save before changing character or retrying the objective.
escalation: Reload the manual save and retry as Kliff.

records.title: Hold evasion may still respond to the default key
records.summary: When Evasion Control is set to Hold, the original evasion key can remain active after remapping.
safeActions: Avoid assigning another critical action to the original evasion key.
Test both the new and original bindings in a safe area.
escalation: Use the default evasion binding until the issue is fixed.

records.title: Damiane can lose shield actions after dying during Shield Toss
records.summary: If Damiane dies immediately after Shield Toss, her shield and related skills may stop working.
safeActions: Save and reload; this is the official workaround.
Confirm shield actions have returned before entering another fight.

records.title: Quest NPCs cannot ride with Legendary Animal mounts
records.summary: NPCs required for quest progression cannot ride together on Legendary Animal mounts.
safeActions: Use a regular compatible mount for passenger objectives.
Do not dismiss the quest NPC while changing mounts.
escalation: Reload before the passenger step if the NPC state becomes stuck.

records.title: Mac furniture placement cursor can be offset
records.summary: At certain resolutions on Mac, the cursor position may differ from the furniture placement point.
safeActions: Try a different supported resolution before placing valuable furniture.
Place a low-value item first to measure the offset.
escalation: Use controller input or a different resolution for placement.

records.title: Mac colourblind mode does not affect the UI
records.summary: The colourblind filter may apply to the scene but not the interface on Mac.
safeActions: Use high-contrast UI options where available.
Do not assume the filter is active on icons or interface states.
escalation: Report specific unreadable screens through official support.

records.title: Rapid virtual-keyboard name entry can freeze PlayStation
records.summary: Rapidly entering a pet or horse name with the PlayStation virtual keyboard may freeze the screen.
safeActions: Enter characters slowly with brief pauses; this is the official workaround.
Save before renaming a pet or horse.
escalation: Close and relaunch only after allowing the console time to respond.

records.title: GTX 1060 can show a white screen with FSR and Frame Generation
records.summary: On NVIDIA GTX 1060, enabling FSR Upscaling and Frame Generation together can make the screen appear white.
safeActions: Disable Frame Generation first.
If the menu is unreadable, restore only the graphics configuration through the least destructive supported method.
escalation: Do not reinstall or delete saves for this symptom; it is a known graphics-setting conflict.

records.title: FSR 4 can remove rain or distort rainy scenes
records.summary: With FSR 4, rainy environments may lose rain or become blurry or distorted.
safeActions: Switch from FSR 4 to another supported upscaler or native rendering.
Re-test in the same rainy location before changing unrelated settings.
escalation: Capture the location, preset and driver version for a report.

records.title: PC crash: safe diagnostic order
records.summary: A reversible crash-triage sequence that preserves saves and avoids unnecessary reinstalls.
safeActions: Create a manual save and copy the local save folder before changing drivers or files.
Confirm Patch 1.15.00 and the launcher update are installed.
Record the crash location, action, graphics preset and driver version.
Return overclocks or undervolts to a known-stable profile.
Lower one high-cost graphics feature at a time and reproduce the same scenario.
escalation: Verify game files only after preserving saves.
Use a driver rollback only when an official issue or reproducible regression supports it.
Reinstall last; it rarely diagnoses a deterministic graphics or save-state defect.

records.title: White screen: upscaling and Frame Generation path
records.summary: Separate an upscaler conflict from display, save or installation problems.
safeActions: Disable Frame Generation before changing resolution or reinstalling.
Switch the upscaler to Off or another supported method.
Apply settings, restart the game and test the same scene.
On GTX 1060, treat FSR plus Frame Generation as a known issue.
escalation: Reset only graphics settings if the menu cannot be used.
Do not delete save data.

records.title: Cloud-save conflict: protect the newest file
records.summary: Prevent an older cloud copy from overwriting the newest local or console save.
safeActions: Stop before choosing either side of a conflict prompt.
Compare timestamps and identify the newest known-good save.
Back up the local PC or Mac save folder where possible.
On PlayStation, check device and cloud timestamps before launching on another console.
Allow platform synchronisation to reach completion before shutdown or device switching.
escalation: Restore a backup only after preserving the current conflicting copies.
Never delete both local and cloud copies to force synchronisation.

records.title: Cross-save upload or refresh failure
records.summary: Safely recover from a failed cross-save upload, refresh or platform-link check.
safeActions: Keep the source platform's manual save untouched.
Confirm linked platforms in Cross-Save Settings.
Stabilise the connection, return to the game and use Refresh.
Upload only after the intended Cross-Save slot is visible.
escalation: Do not overwrite the cross-save slot from a platform with older progress.
Use official account support for platform-link errors.

records.title: Controller or keyboard action conflict
records.summary: Separate a binding conflict from a device, cable or game-state failure.
safeActions: Test the action with default bindings in a safe area.
Disconnect duplicate controllers or virtual-input software.
On PC, DualSense support is USB-only according to the official FAQ.
For Hold evasion, test the original and remapped keys.
escalation: Reset only the input profile before resetting all game settings.
Do not delete saves for an input problem.

records.title: Stable frame-rate tuning order
records.summary: Change one performance layer at a time so gains and image-quality regressions remain attributable.
safeActions: Choose a target mode or frame rate and a repeatable test route.
Set resolution and display mode first.
Choose one upscaler and quality level.
Adjust ray-traced effects next.
Then reduce shadows, volumetrics and reflections.
Reduce textures only when memory pressure or stutter supports it.
Enable Frame Generation last and only on supported PC or Mac hardware.
escalation: Do not copy benchmark values from different hardware as guaranteed results.
Use the official performance-spec notice as a baseline, not a promise.

records.title: Console mode, 120 Hz and VRR selection
records.summary: Choose console presentation settings based on display capability rather than mode names alone.
safeActions: Confirm the display input supports the required refresh rate and bandwidth.
Use HDMI 2.1 where the selected feature requires it.
Enable VRR only on a compatible display.
For Balanced Mode instability around 30–40 FPS, test 120 Hz or disable V-Sync in a VRR-supported environment as officially documented.
escalation: Return to the default 60 Hz output if the display loses signal or behaves unpredictably.
